description: AI interaction features: Tutor/Chat page with streaming, Study/Quiz page, Marks card analysis, and Voice tutor. These are the core AI-powered features. Depends on FEAT-001 (data layer, UI) and FEAT-002 (Library for scope selector). Features in this FEAT are independent of FEAT-004 (gamification) but should leave XP hooks in place as stub calls.
steps: PHASE 8 — Tutor/Chat page: Create src/pages/Tutor.tsx — ChatSessionList on left panel (desktop, collapsible) or slide-over drawer (mobile), ChatWindow as main area, ChatInputBar pinned at bottom. Create src/components/chat/ChatSessionList.tsx — list of ChatSessions from Dexie, grouped by subject (useLiveQuery), 'New chat' button clears chatStore and starts fresh, click to load session (populate chatStore messages from Dexie), delete with confirm dialog. Create src/components/chat/ChatWindow.tsx — scrollable message list (overflow-y auto, flex-col), user bubbles (orange gradient bg, text-white, right-aligned, 20px radius, no tail), assistant bubbles (surface card bg, left-aligned, 4px orange left border, Hoot avatar 32px), auto-scroll to bottom on new message, AnimatePresence for message entrance (slide-up + fade), HootThinkingIndicator while isStreaming. Create src/components/chat/ChatBubble.tsx — renders content: Markdown parsing (bold, italic, inline code, code blocks with orange border, unordered/ordered lists, tables via CSS grid), KaTeX for $...$ (InlineMath) and $$...$$ (BlockMath) using react-katex with throwOnError:false, source chips below assistant messages, 'Read aloud' icon button on assistant messages (connects to useVoice hook). Create src/components/chat/SourceChip.tsx — pill chip 'Source: {docName}, p.{N}', click opens Dialog showing extracted page text with the queried sentence highlighted in orange. Create src/components/chat/HootThinkingIndicator.tsx — Hoot thinking SVG (40px) + 3 dots with staggered pulse animation (Framer Motion). Create src/components/chat/SuggestedFollowUps.tsx — rendered after each complete assistant message, shows 2-3 follow-up chips, clicking populates input field. Create src/components/chat/ChatInputBar.tsx — ModeChips (Guide me / Just explain / Exam answer), LevelChips (Simple / Class level / Topper), ScopeSelector popover, auto-resize textarea (min 1 row, max 6 rows), VoiceInputButton, send button. Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines. Disabled while isStreaming. All chips above input on mobile. Create src/components/chat/ModeChips.tsx — 3 chips with tooltip on each explaining the mode. Create src/components/chat/LevelChips.tsx — 3 chips. Create src/components/chat/ScopeSelector.tsx — Radix Popover: select subject from profile subjects, optionally filter to specific PDFs (checkboxes from db pdfDocuments). Create src/components/chat/VoiceInputButton.tsx — mic icon button, press-to-toggle, calls voice.ts startSTT/stopSTT, animated pulse ring while recording, language badge (EN/HI). Create src/hooks/useChat.ts — manages full chat flow: (1) add user message to db + chatStore, (2) retrieve top-4 BM25 chunks from search index, (3) build payload (last 4 turns + system prompt injected via proxy header hint), (4) call llm.getStreamChatFn()(payload, onDelta, onDone, onError), (5) on onDelta: chatStore.appendDelta, (6) on onDone: parse sources from response, save complete message to db, trigger follow-up generation (small separate LLM call), award XP stub call. Socratic 'Guide me' mode: track hint count in local state; after 3 hints show 'Show full solution' button. Error state: show Hoot sleeping + friendly message + retry button. Session auto-title from first user message (40 char truncation).

PHASE 9 — Study/Quiz page: Create src/pages/Study.tsx — Radix Tabs: Quiz, Flashcards, Revision. Create src/components/quiz/QuizGenerator.tsx — config panel: subject/chapter picker (from profile + db chapterMastery), question type (MCQ/Short/Long/Case-based, multi-select chips), count (5/10/15/20 chips), difficulty (Easy/Medium/Hard chips), 'Previous year style' toggle (enabled when question_paper PDF exists in selected scope), 'Generate' button calls useQuiz hook. Create src/components/quiz/QuizSession.tsx — one question at a time for all types. MCQ: 4 large option chips, single select. Short/Long: auto-resize textarea. Case-based: passage text above, then sub-questions. 'Submit' button → instant feedback: correct answer revealed, brief explanation, marks indicator. 'Next question'. Progress bar (question N of total). Create src/components/quiz/QuizResults.tsx — score display, XP earned (animated counter), weak topics list (questions missed), Hoot celebrating (≥70%) or encouraging (<70%), confetti trigger (≥90%), 'Try again' + 'Back to study' buttons. Create src/components/quiz/QuestionCard.tsx — question number badge, type badge, question text with KaTeX support, instruction text per type. Create src/components/quiz/FlashcardDeck.tsx — card flip with Framer Motion rotateY 180deg, front = question/term, back = answer/definition. Desktop: left arrow = Hard (grade 2), right arrow = Easy (grade 5). Mobile: swipe detection (touchstart/touchend delta). Space = flip. Shows due count badge. Create src/components/quiz/RevisionQueue.tsx — list of due flashcards (getDueCards from spaced.ts), sorted by urgency (most overdue first), overdue badge, 'Start session' button launches FlashcardDeck in due-only mode. Create src/hooks/useQuiz.ts — calls llm.getStreamChatFn() (non-streaming, one-shot) with buildQuizPrompt, parses JSON (try/catch, extract between first { and last }), manages quiz session state (questions array, current index, answers), on complete: saves QuizResult to db, awards XP, updates ChapterMastery, triggers confetti/achievement if ≥90%. Create src/hooks/useFlashcards.ts — useLiveQuery for Flashcard table, SM-2 grade submission updates card via spaced.ts updateCard and writes to db, getDueCards, creates flashcards from LLM response (buildFlashcardPrompt).

PHASE 10 — Marks card analysis: Create src/components/progress/MarksCardUpload.tsx — upload widget for marks card (image PNG/JPG or PDF). Images: direct to Tesseract.js createWorker OCR. PDFs: pdf.ts processPDF. Shows Hoot thinking + progress. On text extracted: calls llm buildMarksPrompt, streams response, parses JSON. On success: calls setExtractedMarks prop. On JSON parse failure: shows raw text in a textarea for manual review. Hoot happy on success. Create src/components/progress/MarksTable.tsx — editable table: columns Subject, Obtained/Max with inline edit (click cell → input), percentage auto-computed and colour-coded (green ≥80%, orange 60-79%, red <60%), add row button, delete row button, validation (obtained ≤ max, both numbers). 'Confirm & Save' saves to db MarksEntry, updates ChapterMastery for each subject. Create src/components/progress/MarksChart.tsx — Recharts BarChart, one bar per subject, bar colour from percentage (green/orange/red via Cell), ResponsiveContainer, custom tooltip showing percentage. Create src/components/progress/ImprovementPlan.tsx — post-confirmation: LLM call with weak subjects (obtained/max <70%) → 200-word improvement plan text. Rendered in Card with Hoot encouraging. 'Generate plan' button (not auto, to save tokens). Connect MarksCardUpload to Library page (special 'Upload Marks Card' button) and Progress page.

PHASE 13 — Voice tutor: Create src/components/chat/VoiceTutor.tsx — 'Read aloud' panel: triggered by 'Read aloud' button in ChatBubble. Shows sentence list with current sentence highlighted in orange. Speed slider: 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x. 'Stop' button. 'Pause'/'Resume' if speechSynthesis.pause/resume available. Create src/hooks/useVoice.ts — wraps voice.ts. State: activeSentenceIndex (number), isSpeaking, isPaused, availableVoices (filtered for en-IN and hi-IN), selectedLang. SpeechSynthesis.getVoices() populated via onvoiceschanged event. Sentence boundary: split text on /[.?!।]+/ to get sentences array, use utterance.onboundary charIndex to find current sentence index. Update src/components/chat/ChatBubble.tsx — add 'Read aloud' icon button (lucide Volume2) below each assistant message, clicking calls useVoice.speak(message.content, lang). Update src/components/chat/VoiceInputButton.tsx — add EN/HI language toggle that persists to appStore.language and uses 'en-IN' or 'hi-IN' for recognition lang. Graceful no-op in all voice components when window.speechSynthesis or window.SpeechRecognition is undefined.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build:typecheck exits with 0 TypeScript errors after all steps
npm run build completes without errors
Tutor page renders ChatWindow, ChatInputBar with ModeChips/LevelChips, ChatSessionList
ChatBubble renders markdown, KaTeX math expressions, and source chips
Study page shows Quiz/Flashcards/Revision tabs with working generators
QuizSession shows one question at a time with MCQ options or textarea, and results screen after submit
MarksCardUpload accepts image/PDF, shows progress, renders editable MarksTable
MarksChart shows bar chart coloured by performance
VoiceTutor 'Read aloud' button appears on assistant bubbles and calls speechSynthesis
